newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - UniMark buy repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - UniMark buy repeated.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw said Tuesday it reiterated its buy rating on the UniMark Group Inc.

-- "We spent a few days in Mexico with UniMark last week and came away confident that UniMark is rolling out new products, widening distribution channels, turning around the New England operation and positioning for the long-term," Rodman analyst Ronald Morrow said in a report.
-- He said he continues to anticipate a loss in the fourth quarter and a "tough" first half of 1997, but added the longer term outlook remains positive.
